summary: A form label that underlines its keyboard shortcut letter and focuses its control when clicked.
description: A customized built-in <label is="moz-label"> (extends HTMLLabelElement). Underlines (or appends in parentheses) the character in its text content matching its accesskey, following the platform convention of whether accesskeys are shown underlined at all, and focuses/activates the control referenced by its control attribute (or the labelable control it wraps) when clicked.

attributes.name: accesskey
attributes.description: Key used for keyboard access; also propagated onto the labeled control element. Only the first character is used.

attributes.name: shownaccesskey
attributes.description: A key to underline for display purposes without registering it as the real accesskey; works around multiple-accesskey elements being focused instead of activated.

attributes.name: enable-center-crop
attributes.description: Presence-only. Sets crop="center" and, if no value attribute is set yet, copies the element's current textContent into it. While present, the overridden textContent getter returns the value attribute instead of the element's real text.

attributes.name: control
attributes.description: The id of the control this label is for; used to look up labeledControlElement.

methods.name: formatAccessKey
methods.description: Re-renders the underlined/parenthesized accesskey markup inside the label's text content; runs automatically on connect and whenever the label's content or accesskey attribute changes.
